name: Uptime Kuma
description: Gives AI clients the live state of the monitors on an Uptime Kuma status page (status, last message, last check, 24-hour uptime) together with the Phoedox entry each monitor belongs to (matched by host name, address or name). Read-only, no import. Settings: url (e.g. https://status.example.org) and status_page (the slug of a status page that lists the monitors). Uses only the public status page JSON, so no credentials are needed; the plugin reads the knowledge graph only to find matching entries.

mcpTools.name: uptimekuma.status
mcpTools.description: All monitors of the status page: name, group, current status (up, down, pending, maintenance), last message, last check time, 24-hour uptime in percent and the matching Phoedox entry.

mcpTools.name: uptimekuma.down
mcpTools.description: Only the monitors of the status page that are not up (down, pending, maintenance or without heartbeat), with the matching Phoedox entry.
